Equal Roots, Class 10 board exam: find k so that 2x² + kx + 3 = 0 has two equal roots.

• Equal roots means the discriminant b² − 4ac = 0
• a = 2, b = k, c = 3, so k² − 24 = 0
• k² = 24, so k = ±√24 = ±2√6
